profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Co-founder of Plusteam  | AI Enthusiast
profile.summary:
Tech enthusiast and experienced software engineer with a robust background in agile project management, systems design, full stack web development, and cloud computing. 

With over 10 years of experience in designing and implementing modern web solutions. I am the Founder of an agile software agency that has been delivering custom solutions and deploying systems for over 30 clients globally for the past 7 years. 

Passionate about contributing my expertise, solving complex problems, driving growth, and tackling challenging projects.

positions.title: Co-founder
positions.description:
Plusteam is an Agile Software Factory specialized in modern web development. We love to help our clients to reach their maximum potential through technology and become their tech partners to build high-quality products and services for this digital age.

As Founder and CTO I have been working for different clients around the world. We have built solutions with the best technologies for each requirement. These are some techs that we have used for them: Single Page Apps, Progressive Web Apps, UI/UX Design, GraphQL, and RESTs APIs, Headless CMS, E-commerce solutions, Odoo ERP implementation and customization, Blockchain solutions Dapps, and Web 3.0

positions.title: Full Stack Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I'm a specialist building modern web apps using edge technologies. I'm able to be on charge of development (frontend and backend), Database administration, DevOps (Deployments, CI/CD, Monitoring), Project management and QA (TDD/BDD)

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: Experiencias Virtuales y desarrollos con Metaversos, Realidad Virtual, y Realidad Aumentada

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was involved in the development and maintenance of a web app for social events management that is used by different US institutions in the areas of golf, charity, poker, gala, and other events.

Some of the technologies and tools used were: ColdFusion, Microsoft SQL Server, jQuery, D3.js, Jira, Git, HTML5, CSS3, ES5, Selenium.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Involved in development of software solutions in oil area. I created a "core" for all new software products of the company and did some others works in company products. I used the follow technologies: C#, ASP.NET MVC 5, Kendo-UI and Microsoft SQL Server.

positions.title: Consultor de Software
positions.description:
Consultor y desarrollador de aplicaciones web involucrado en el desarrollo de proyectos internos. Mi labor fue crear diferentes modulos para sistemas de recursos humanos y control de acceso de junto con el equipo de desarrollo del departamento de sistemas de la compañía.

Algunas de las tecnologías utilizadas fueron: Java EE, JSF 2, Primefaces, JPA (Eclipse-Link), IBM Informix, SubVersion, HTML5, CSS3, ES5.
